newsitem.title: USA: Lycos Q4 revenue jumps 72 percent from Q3.
newsitem.headline: Lycos Q4 revenue jumps 72 percent from Q3.

text.p: Internet navigation company Lycos Inc said fourth quarter revenue surged 72 percent from the third quarter to $2.7 million, boosted by increased numbers of advertisers and licensing partners.

The company reported a net loss of $2.2 million, or a per- share loss of $0.16, for the quarter, compared with analyst estimates which ranged from a loss of $0.16 a share to a $0.20 a share loss, according to First Call.

"With the continued strong growth we have experienced, we intend to continue to invest heavily to enhance our services, extend our brand, establish more business partners around the globe and attract more advertisers," Lycos president and chief executive Robert Davis said in a statement.
Lycos said the number of its licensees rose to 24 at the end of its fiscal year on July 31, while the number of advertisers rose to 160 during July from 112 during April.
